name: print-social-business-and-data-posts-with-blue-ring-photo-frames
title: 'Business & Data' navy pack with greyscale meeting photos inside blue rings and arcs
whatItIs: Nine navy square posts with greyscale office photos masked into circles and ringed with thick cyan-to-blue arcs, a blue slanted-stripe logo, bold 'BUSINESS & DATA' headlines, triangle patterns and small hashtags.
whatItMeans: Techy and serious; bright rings energise sober photos and tie the series together.
techniques: Desaturate photos so the brand blue carries the colour.
Wrap photos with thick partial rings.
Repeat a bold title lockup on every post.
Add tiny triangle patterns as tech texture.

vocabulary.definition: An incomplete circle stroke around a shape.
